key.name: enable-css
key.description: Restyle notifications, popovers, and quick-settings to strict mono.

key.name: enable-glyph-led
key.description: Spawn a row of pulsing dots along the bottom edge of the primary monitor when notifications arrive.

key.name: enable-idle-overlay
key.description: Show a centered pulsing Ndot animation when the session has been idle for N minutes.

key.name: idle-timeout-ms
key.description: How long the session must be idle before the overlay appears.

key.name: enable-top-bar-clock
key.summary: Replace top-bar clock with Ndot 57 clock

key.name: dashboard-hotkey
key.summary: Hotkey to toggle the dashboard overlay
